summary.title: SecureNova AI Platform
summary.description: SecureNova’s AI customer-support agent answers customer questions and takes actions such as order lookups and refunds. Customers log in through Auth0 (Authorization Code + PKCE, MFA). The AI agent uses an OAuth M2M client to get short-lived tokens, calls an external LLM with an API key, retrieves documents through a RAG pipeline, and executes tools through an MCP server that calls internal APIs. This model covers six identities: human users, AI agent, OAuth M2M client, LLM API key, RAG pipeline service identity and MCP server identity.

diagrams.description: End-to-end flow of one customer request: login, chat, RAG retrieval, LLM call and tool execution via MCP.
